moments.title: Taylor Swift scores new UK #1 with 'Patient Zero'

angles.name: Chart Double
angles.copy: Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' is #1 AND 'The Life of a Showgirl' is #1 album! That's her fifth chart double. Unstoppable!
